description: Unit tests for the HttpNetworkLayer class in Chromium's net/http module, including tests for transaction creation, suspension, GET requests, network verification, proxy fallback, and error handling.

classes.name: HttpNetworkLayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing HttpNetworkLayer, including setup of mock socket factory, host resolver, and network session.

methods.name: CreateAndDestroy
methods.description: Test for creating and destroying an HttpTransaction.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Test for suspending and resuming the HttpNetworkLayer.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Test for performing a simple GET request and verifying response content.

methods.name: NetworkVerified
methods.description: Test to verify that network_accessed is true after a successful request.

methods.name: NetworkUnVerified
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when a network error occurs during a request.
